cover.title: Stop ignoring Thanksgiving phone calls
cover.subtitle: How to capture every emergency call while you eat dinner.

slides.heading: The holiday dinner interruption
slides.body: When a main line backs up on Thanksgiving afternoon, homeowners do not leave long voicemails. They hang up and call the next plumber.
slides.tip: Call your own business number right now and time how long it rings before voicemail picks up.

slides.heading: Why speed wins the rush
slides.body: The first plumbing company to answer picks up the job. If your phone goes to voicemail during dinner, that emergency call is gone.
slides.tip: Say: 'I can get a tech there by 3. Want that slot?'

slides.heading: Keep your team off duty
slides.body: Your crew and office staff need time off with their families. Working through holidays leads directly to employee burnout and expensive turnover.
slides.tip: Check your holiday missed call log from last year to see exactly how many jobs walked away.

slides.heading: Holiday booking quick checklist
slides.body: Answer every ring around the clock, qualify the real emergencies instantly, and book the job straight into your calendar without delay.
slides.tip: Review your call routing rules before Wednesday afternoon to ensure seamless coverage.

caption:
Holiday emergency calls will not wait until Monday morning.

When families gather, plumbing systems take a beating from heavy use. If your phone rings to voicemail, those high-paying emergency jobs go straight elsewhere.
